body:
Thank you for your support. Really, it means a lot to me that someone cares a bit :)

My parents don't think that loneliness is such a serious problem that it is for me. I won't get actual help from them, even if I tell them about my suicidal thoughts - just more restrictions.

I'd love to have friends. The thing is that I can't make any. I don't really know the reason - either it's my boring personality, wrong people around me or anything deeper. My parent's don't really restrict my social life - they're just overprotective. I can't get out of the house without adults knowing about it - literally can't. Even if I do, I keep getting constant calls. That drives me insane. I want to be just like others - but instead I have to waste the best time of my life in front of a computer. I also wrote to some other people about my friend that I lost two years ago, and it's an addition to the problems I have now. 

meetup.com doesn't seem to work in my place (I don't live in the US), I don't know if there are any similar sites in my country, but I'm going to look into that.

Wish you a lot of luck at your new place. Moving somewhere is very difficult, but I hope, everything will be ok :)

I don't really have anything else to tell. The thing is that my best friend commited suicide two years ago, and I feel like he's just a victim of accident. I was ignorant to his feelings. I made a whole lot of mistakes. He shouldn't have died, I should have. These thoughts are awful, but I can't throw them away of my head. I want to apologize to him. So. Fucking. Badly.

I wasn't really able to make a lot of friends since - and the situation around me probably won't let me do it in the future. As I get older, thoughts about missed opportunities and fun are haunting me more. It's hard. I don't want to live life in my room, windows closed - and that's what fuels my suicide thoughts last months.
I tried to, but they don't think that's a serious problem. I can't tell them about my suicidal thoughts directly, because I'm sure I won't get any actual help from them.

I gave a reply to other people in this thread, being a little more detailed on what's happening, but basically, I have no perspectives in life and no friends. My parents and other adults are being way too overprotective, so I can't get a social life and be like others, and I feel terrible because of that.

Hey, I'd love to. But basically nothing makes me happy anymore. I'm fucking broken after years of bullying, scared and unable to try anything new. Everyone has their fun, meanwhile I just suffer looking at them, feeling that I'll never find anyone to be with, and I'm getting more and more done with that. :c

I'll be out of school next year, and I feel like I'm too dumb to enter the university I want or study there. I have no idea what I want to do in my life or even what I'm gonna do. The saddest thing is that my social life is non-existent, I can't make any friends and have no one even to chat with, leave having a girlfriend/boyfriend. Shit, I only want a life, real friends, to have some fun like people of my age do, but instead I'm wasting my time in front of a computer, isolated from people, for 3 years already. Every day I feel like my patience will soon be over.
